$schema: lanes allowed to report not-run (visible-skip discipline, e2e ADR-0001)
comment: A lane listed here may report 'not run' without failing the run — but the report is LOUD and names its tracking issue. A lane that BUILDS while listed here fails the run: a stale entry is drift, and removing it is part of the tracking issue. E2E-1 (#5) rebuilt the Swift client as a Protocol v1 Scenario Driver and emptied its entry; the Rust client is NOT an SDK driver — per e2e ADR-0001 'SDK matrix' and issue #5 it becomes the Adversary Client base, so its repair moved to E2E-5 (#9).

rust-interop.reason: clients/rust uses the pre-SYNC-15 core FFI (TruesealFfiSession + callback traits), which the canonical core (trueseal-sync#107) removed. Per e2e ADR-0001 'SDK matrix' the Rust client is not part of the SDK matrix — it becomes the Adversary Client base, rebuilt in E2E-5 (#9).
